title: Sign-in page renders with email and password fields
expected: Login form shows email + password inputs and a Sign in button

title: Wrong password is rejected without revealing which field was wrong
expected: Inline error shown, user stays on /login, no session granted

title: Protected route redirects an unauthenticated visitor to /login
expected: Visiting /library while signed out lands on /login

title: Sidebar lists conversations grouped by recency
expected: Conversation list renders with at least one group heading and one thread

title: Workspace health card reports indexed and excluded documents
expected: Health card shows counts that match /api/documents statuses
actual: api: 10 documents, 8 ready, 2 not ready; card rendered=true

title: Sidebar search filters conversations and queries the server
expected: Typing a term narrows the list; clearing restores it

title: Library lists every document with type, pages and status
expected: A row per document from /api/documents, including non-ready ones with their status

title: A failed document surfaces its failure rather than disappearing
expected: The failed Exhibit Bundle is listed with a failure status, not hidden

title: Upload dialog states the real limits from the server
expected: Dropzone names PDF/DOCX/TXT, 50 MB, 500 pages, 50 documents — matching /api/config

title: An unsupported file type is rejected per-file with the reason named
expected: The .pptx is rejected and the reason names the accepted types; the batch is not failed
actual: dialog mentions the rejected file and accepted types=true

title: Uploading a TXT contract runs the real pipeline through to ready
expected: Document reaches status=ready, classified as contract, with chunks embedded into Qdrant
actual: id=doc_01a13a85078879b598a7989c status=ready type=contract pages=3 | Uploaded:done | Text extracted:done | Layout QA passed:done | Classified:done | Chunked:done | Embedded & indexed:done

title: A newly uploaded document becomes selectable as retrieval scope
expected: The uploaded contract appears in the scope picker ready list

title: Mode chips switch between Auto, Ask, Summary and Draft
expected: Each chip becomes aria-checked when selected and the composer adapts

title: Summary mode exposes a document chooser defaulted to a ready document
expected: A "Summarise" select appears listing ready documents only
actual: visible=true default="doc_01a13a85078879b598a7989c" options=["Choose a document…","Calder-Ridgeway-Supply-Agreement","Orion-Vertex-Services-Agreement","test-nda","Executed Amendment No. 3 (scanned)","Mutual NDA — Harbour Point Capital","Complaint — Tessara Fabrication v. Juneau M…","Delmar Holdings v. Castellan, 2024 WL 88120…"]

title: Draft mode refuses to send until its required parameters are supplied
expected: A blocker message is shown and Send stays disabled with no sources/question
actual: blocker="Choose at least one source document for the draft." sendDisabled=true settingsBadge=true

title: Scope picker shows non-ready documents disabled, with the reason
expected: Indexing and failed documents are listed struck through with an exclusion reason
actual: exclusion reason shown for non-ready documents=true

title: Settings page renders data & privacy information
expected: /settings loads without error and shows account and data controls
actual: page text length=3375, shows account email=true

title: An unknown route shows the 404 page rather than a blank screen
expected: /no-such-page redirects to /404 with a not-found message

title: Document viewer opens a document and renders its pages
expected: /doc/{id} shows the document name and page surfaces

title: Valid credentials sign in and land on the chat workspace
expected: Session established, composer and sidebar visible, /api/auth/me returns the user

title: New chat plus a first question creates and opens a conversation
expected: URL becomes /c/{id}, the thread appears in the sidebar, and GET /api/conversations/{id} returns it
actual: id=c_01a13c19f14f700faab67e6b GET=200 title="What happens if a change of control occurs without…" inSidebarList=true (was 9 conversations)

title: Ask streams a grounded answer over the real retrieval pipeline
expected: The turn completes with non-empty prose and persists as status=complete
actual: stored status=complete kind=answer intent=ask textChars=914 renderedChars=1138

title: Every citation chip resolves to a real document, page and span
expected: At least one [n] chip rendered, and each stored citation carries documentId, page and spanId

title: Hovering a citation previews the source passage without leaving the answer
expected: Hover card names the document and page and shows the retrieved excerpt text

title: Clicking a citation opens the evidence panel on the retrieved passage
expected: Evidence panel is visible and contains the excerpt the citation points at
actual: panelVisible=true excerptsStored=2 panelContainsRetrievedText=true probe="4.3 Consequences of an Unconsented Chang"

title: The stage trace reports the retrieval pipeline that actually ran
expected: Stages include retrieving, reranking, assembling, writing and verifying with timings

title: The turn states the scope it searched and names what it excluded
expected: scopeUsed lists the searched documents and gives a reason for each excluded one
actual: searched=9 documents / 421 pages; excluded=2 (Deposition Transcript : Still indexing — not yet searchable | Exhibit Bundle C (fax): Failed to process — cannot be searched)

title: A completed answer carries the attorney work-product disclaimer
expected: Disclaimer text is persisted on the turn and shown beneath the answer
actual: stored="Attorney work-product aid generated by Legal Lens. Not legal advice. Verify every citation" shownInUi=true

title: A citation opens the cited document at the cited page
expected: Open document navigates to /doc/{id}?page={n}&span={spanId} matching the citation
actual: citation [1] → Orion-Vertex-Services-Agreem p2; url=/doc/doc_01a13830bbca72a2a7bd4a75?page=2&span=doc_01a13830bbca72a2a7bd4a75:2:0-688 documentMatch=true pageMatch=true spanMatch=true

title: Renaming a conversation updates the sidebar and persists server-side
expected: New title shown in the sidebar and returned by GET /api/conversations/{id}
actual: before="What happens if a change of control occurs without…" after(server)="Change of control — Orion/Vertex consent analysis" shownInSidebar=true

title: Deleting a conversation removes it from the list and from the API
expected: Confirmation dialog names the thread; after deleting, GET returns 404 and the row is gone
actual: confirmDialogWarnedIrreversible=true; after delete GET=404 stillInList=false rowRemovedFromSidebar=true
